Grilled Cheese
By: Jenny Richards
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 11:42pm

Ingredients




2 slices bread per sandwich
2 slices cheese per sandwich
1 tablespoon butter
Skillet or sandwich maker

Preparation

1 Spread butter on outside of bread  2 Place cheese between 2 slices 3 Fry in skillet, until cheese melts and bread is golden brown

About


The traditional grilled cheese sandwich is American cheese between two slices of white bread. This version is a ooey-gooey classic (and kid favorite), but there are so many ways it jazz it up. Experiment with different breads and cheeses. Add a slice of tomato, pickles, grilled onions, ham, or bacon to make the grilled cheese truly divine. Serve with a bowl of tomato soup on the side for dunking.
